entry.title: dotnet/aspnetcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-07-15
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • NET10 Blazor Server Hot Reload is still very slow and here are the numbers to prove it #62740
  • HttpRequest.Headers returns odd result in multiple headers of same type #62738
  • Perf regression: json #62737
  • Perf improvement: fortunes, fortunes #62736
  • No check for salt size before allocating array when validating password #62732
  • aspnetcore repo survey summer 2025 #62731
  • Adding AddHttpMessageHandler<BaseAddressAuthorizationMessageHandler>() to AddHttpClient call results in a "Specified cast is not valid" error #62730
  • Obsolete ResponseCaching #62728
    10.0-rc1
  • Getting error RSG002: TargetPath not specified for additional file: running dotnet watch run for blazor project #62725
  • JSDisconnectedException hinders debugging in Visual Studio #62724
  • Impossible to modify ValidationProblemDetails when validation in Minimal APIs is triggered #62723
  • ObjectDisposedException in Blazor server rendered app #62718

Closed

  • Obsolete ConcurrencyLimiter #62686
  • Analyzer warning for missing XML doc on source-generated Program class #61783
  • Zero size css after Blazor Web App is published #62697
  • Perf improvement: json #62722
  • Deprecating `area-web-frameworks` label #57452
    .NET 10 Planning
  • Perf regression: ApiCrudAddProduct #62717
  • Microsoft.Extensions.Http.Polly depends on deprecated Polly.Extensions.Http #62721

PullRequests

Created

  • [SignalR] Don't throw for message headers in Java client #62739
    area-signalr, feature-client-java
  • [Blazor] Extract HotReload for WebAssembly #62735
    area-blazor, feature-blazor-wasm, 10.0-preview7
  • #62732 Fix password validation in PasswordHasher`1: add bound check for salt size before array allocation #62734
    area-identity, community-contribution
  • Localized file check-in by OneLocBuild Task: Build definition ID 1159: Build ID 2750625 #62733
    area-mvc

Merged

  • XML doc for generated public partial Program class #62726
    area-infrastructure, community-contribution, 10.0-preview7
  • Upgrade Microsoft.OpenApi to 2.0.0 #62719
    Attention: Shared Code Modified, 10.0-preview7

Updated

  • Replace WebHostBuilder with HostBuilder pattern in MVC folder #62703
    area-mvc
  • Feature for setting activity tags on creation #62090
    community-contribution, pending-ci-rerun, area-networking
  • Support `NotFound` content rendering for a custom Router #62635
    area-blazor, 10.0-preview7
  • Changed css classes assignment in RenderPlaceholderRow #62709
    area-blazor
  • Fix. Quickgrid PropertyColumn Align property doesn't work with Align.Right #62707
    area-blazor
  • [blazor] fix multiple calls to OnConnectionDownAsync #62518
    area-blazor, pending-ci-rerun, 10.0-preview7
  • QuickGrid: Adds EmptyContentTemplate #62603
    area-blazor, community-contribution
  • Add validation to Router component to prevent both NotFound and NotFoundPage being set #62625
    Attention: Shared Code Modified, 10.0-preview7
  • Add CreateScopeForStatusCodePages property and UseStatusCodePagesWithReExecute overload #62624
    Attention: Shared Code Modified, 10.0-preview7
  • Identity metrics clean up #62671
    area-identity
  • QuickGrid: Adds option to disable rendering of filler rows #62607
    area-blazor, community-contribution
  • QuickGrid: Adds Multi Column Sorting #62604
    area-blazor, community-contribution
  • Deprecate IActionContextAccessor #62647
    Attention: Shared Code Modified
  • [main] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #62664
    area-infrastructure, Type: Dependency Update :arrow_up_small:, build-ops
